- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Jonathan, Mizuki, Rin, Misaki and Benjamin. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day).
